_comment: Converter registry for `pxd convert`. Keys starting with _ are ignored. path, env values and deployment_files expand ~ and ${VAR} (from the env block first, then the environment). Optional pins: sha256 (of path), deployment_sha256 {file: sha256} and tree_sha256 (every file the tool may load; pxd tools prints it); a mismatch refuses the tool. recipe_deployment_sha256 {file: earlier sha256} keeps the recipe name of a relinked deployment. Install converters, their libraries and runtimes where only maintainers can write: pxd refuses a tool whose deployment, env directories or ldd libraries others can change (see docs/CONFIGURATION.md and docs/PERMISSIONS.md). The env block is recorded in every conversion's provenance (manifest and catalogue): never put secrets there. ${VAR} refers to variables defined earlier in the same env block or to the environment.

openms-fileconverter.note: OpenMS FileConverter built with the Thermo RawFileReader bridge (.NET)

mzpeak-convert.note: mzPeak converter for Bruker .d, Thermo .raw and mzML

thermorawfileparser.why: ThermoRawFileParser 2.0.0 writes wrong mzML index offsets (validated after conversion when allowed)
